info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Investment Management By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update investment portfolios by specifying parameters. Users can modify key aspects of their investment strategies, ensuring alignment with financial goals and compliance requirements. It serves financial institutions and investment managers looking to optimize their portfolio planning processes. This endpoint allows modification of investment details to reflect current market conditions and client preferences.
